extracted.name: Bacon and Date Appetizer
extracted.description: Dates are stuffed with almonds, wrapped in bacon, and broiled until the bacon's crispy in this easy appetizer.
instruction_lines: Slit dates. Place one almond inside each date. Wrap dates with bacon, using toothpicks to hold them together.
Broil 10 minutes, or until bacon is evenly brown and crisp.
